reviewBasis: General-English meaning and direction, independent of result ranks or Code permissions and classifications

reviews.reason: A general practitioner or family doctor is a physician and therefore a healthcare professional.
A paper or audit trail is a sequence of records and documentation.
Record keeping is the maintenance of records and documentation.
Supporting paperwork and documents are forms of documentation; the narrower verification-document target has been removed.
Putting something in writing produces a written record or documentation without implying approval.
An attendance certificate or other proof of attendance is attendance proof; the attendance-list inference has been removed.
Expense receipts are accounting records, but proof of spending can also be nonaccounting evidence; qualify or split that broader source.
Proof of travel and travel receipts are forms of travel evidence; the narrower ticket target has been removed.
A breakdown of actual spending is not a budget breakdown of planned spending; neither proposed target preserves that distinction. Use an itemised expense target in a separate proposal if useful.
Enrolment certificates and other proof of enrolment concern enrollment, without assuming a particular certificate form.
Sign-off and a go-ahead are ordinary approval language.
Advance or prior notice is a notification given beforehand and does not imply consent.
Pre-approval and prior authorisation are approvals obtained in advance.
Independent or impartial review is a review process; the independent-decision inference has been removed.
Background and integrity checks are examples of due diligence when assessing a counterparty.
Screening a distributor is a specific due diligence activity and carries no medical-screening implication.
Supplier, partner, and third-party screening are counterparty due diligence activities.
Risk analysis, review, and evaluation are forms of risk assessment.
Ongoing compliance checks are monitoring and continuing oversight.
Supervision is a form of oversight without implying a formal audit.
Contractual duties and requirements are obligations under a contract.
Ending or cancelling a contract is a form of termination.
Remedial measures are corrective action without necessarily being a sanction.
Competitive bidding can describe the seller's bid, not a buyer's purchasing arrangement; use buyer-side procurement or tender wording as the source.
A public tender and government procurement are narrower forms of public procurement.
A purchasing or buying process is procurement in ordinary business language.
A price reduction is a price concession; the narrower rebate target has been removed.
An added-value offer is a value add in ordinary commercial language.
Financial difficulties and distress describe financial hardship without importing a threshold.
General running is an incomplete cost phrase and may match unrelated running; use general running expenses as the target, without equating all operating expenses to overheads.
Emergency relief can respond to a local or personal emergency, not necessarily a disaster; disaster relief would be a safe narrower source.
A philanthropic or charity donation is a charitable donation.
A fundraising dinner or charity fundraiser is a fundraising activity; the targets assert no separate cause.
Going rate and market rate are useful ordinary-language bridges to market value; the mapping does not assert a valuation formula.
Carrying value and carrying amount are accounting terms for book value.
Asset depreciation is depreciation; the broad loss-in-value source has been removed.
Manufacturing and production costs are costs of manufacture; the internal-cost inference has been removed.
Delivery, shipping, and freight costs are narrower logistics costs.
Rental value and equivalent rent are close ordinary descriptions of a rental-equivalent value.
A noncash or nonmonetary contribution is a contribution in kind.
Noncash support or goods supplied instead of cash are forms of in-kind support.
Donated time, services, or equipment are noncash contributions and may be described as in kind.
Staff hours and employee time are narrower instances of time spent.
Used or second-hand equipment is a type of used goods.
Borrowed or loaned equipment is temporarily loaned goods, with no evaluation purpose implied.
A research partnership may only fund or sponsor research without joint work; keep joint and cooperative research, and remove research partnership.
The source now specifies product evaluation after sale, a narrower form of post-market product evaluation.
Product-user feedback is feedback, and the broader target asserts no research classification.
A study grant may fund a student's education rather than research; use research study grant as a narrower source if needed.
Royalty income and licensing royalties are royalties; generic licensing income has been removed.
Inventor payment does not identify the payment basis and may be salary, a prize, or a royalty; compensation is too inferential.
Co-development and joint development are narrower forms of development without implying ownership.
Lodging a grievance is submitting a complaint.
Settling a dispute or reaching an amicable settlement is dispute resolution.
Challenging or contesting a decision is an appeal in ordinary language; the mapping does not assert a formal appeal right.
An unidentified or unnamed complainant makes the complaint anonymous to the recipient.
Keeping information private is confidential handling, distinct from anonymous submission.
A formal written rebuke is a written reprimand.
Hands-on training and practical workshops involve practical or hands-on sessions.
Surgical simulation is a specific simulation and does not imply live surgery.
A standalone course is stand-alone without asserting an event classification.
Equipment return is too generic for a search bridge to bare return, which loses all equipment context and is highly ambiguous.
Cadaver training and a cadaver lab concern cadavers without implying a Code event category.
An event timetable or conference schedule is represented by a programme or agenda.
Holiday is much broader than holiday season, and a holiday season need not be a touristic season; remove those targets or use peak season as the broader term.
Ski, beach, and holiday resorts are narrower kinds of resort without a venue ruling.
An online seminar is an online or virtual event.
A disclosure or publication deadline concerns the timing of disclosure or publication without encoding a date.
A reporting year is a reporting period; the ambiguous reporting-timeframe source has been removed.
Annual reporting and yearly disclosure describe yearly frequency and a reporting period, without naming a fiscal year.
Combined totals are aggregate amounts in ordinary arithmetic language.
Itemised disclosure and itemised payments are both itemised; the target no longer asserts that every itemised payment is disclosed.
A subsidiary is an affiliated company; the one-way direction is correct.
Overseas or international activity is cross-border activity; the bare ambiguous words have been qualified.
Voluntary reporting need not be disclosure, especially public disclosure; retain optional disclosure and use voluntary disclosure as the other source.
Duplicate or double reporting is the same information being reported twice.
Publicly available information is publicly accessible; the legally distinct public-domain target has been removed.
A broken or dead link is still a link; the mapping promises no repair guidance.
Correcting or amending published data is a modification or amendment.
Correcting data or an error is an amendment or modification, without implying a sanction.

How long information remains online concerns public availability, while retention may refer to private storage after removal; keep retention period to retention and handle online availability separately.
Calculation method and approach can be described as methodology or calculation rules.
A currency conversion rate is an exchange rate; the bare ambiguous conversion-rate source has been removed.
Withdrawing permission can concern a licence or authorisation rather than consent; keep withdraw consent and revoke consent only.
Partial permission does not necessarily mean partial consent; permission and consent can be legally and practically different.
A cancelled grant is an instance of cancellation without asserting a reporting treatment.
An agreement lasting several years is a multi-year agreement, without assuming any particular duration rule.
With VAT and including VAT mean the value includes VAT.
Without VAT and excluding VAT mean the value excludes VAT.
A change or revision history does not by itself imply a version-control process or complete traceability; use revision record or change log instead.
Data accuracy and accurate reporting are narrower uses of accuracy.
A raffle or lottery is ordinarily a chance-based prize draw; the mapping says nothing about permission or limits.
Additional reporting and extra disclosures are not equivalent to bare additional or disclosure, which lose the requested extra-reporting concept and create noise.
Stricter and more restrictive are ordinary equivalents of more stringent; the mapping sets no jurisdictional rule.
Keeping or retaining ownership means retaining legal title, with no equipment-use classification implied.
A payment breakdown is itemised in some form; the target no longer asserts public disclosure.
Downloadable means available for download, without claiming that the file contents are indexed.
A free or complimentary booth remains booth space; no sponsorship or grant category is inferred.
Golf and ski holidays are leisure activities and often entertainment, with no permission or event category asserted.
On-sale can also mean a discounted retail offer or first sale, rather than resale; use onward sale as a target or omit this ambiguous bridge.
